output.summary: Associate attrition is 14.1% trailing, below the firm's 15.0% five-year average and the regional median of 18%. Clustered resignations have occurred before. Both September leavers had decided on other grounds months earlier, so the Friday change did not cause those exits. Flexibility satisfaction fell 3.9 to 3.1, mostly over the end of remote Fridays, yet intent to stay is flat and does not differ between low and high flexibility raters. This looks like focused grumbling over a deliberate, monitored tradeoff, not a crisis. Do not spend $660k on bonuses or hunt the kitchen speakers. Keep the existing triggers and January review, explain the rationale, and consider small accommodations at the edges. The skills benefit is unproven until blind grading (Q1) and the March 2027 reassessment.
